_doc: Third-party asset/tool ledger for the SWAY asset factory. Entries with decision ADOPT/ADAPT require an allow-listed licence, archived licence text, retrieval date, rights confirmation and (once files exist) file hashes. NOTHING external has been downloaded or incorporated yet: this authoring environment had no network access to the download hosts. See RESEARCH_AND_ADOPTION_REPORT.md.
